visualCharacteristics.description: Photo beside a text panel (bold heading, copy, optional square #0066b2 button). Default unframed; 'card' variant = shadowed columns with centred heading/button. Stacks on mobile.

contentPattern.description: 1 row, 2 cells: [photo | heading + paragraph + button]. Cells render in authored order; empty spacer paragraphs are dropped; a single standalone link paragraph becomes the button.
contentPattern.structure: 1 row x 2 cells: [photo | heading + paragraph + button]
